query: select count(*) functions,md5(string_agg(n.nspname||'|'||p.oid::regprocedure::text||'|'||pg_get_functiondef(p.oid),E'\n' order by n.nspname collate "C",p.oid::regprocedure::text collate "C")) definitions_md5 from pg_proc p join pg_namespace n on n.oid=p.pronamespace where n.nspname in ('public','finance_private') and p.prokind='f';
